source_request: 은꼴사에 초점을 맞춰서 컨셉 만들어서 다시 한번 독립된 환경의 서브에이전트에서 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: One unmistakably adult fashion subject continues an unfinished self-directed hair-gathering action that visibly moves and holds one exact stable hair-and-garment boundary. That changed boundary reveals or re-covers one bounded non-explicit upper-back, shoulder, or collarbone interval framed by a fully opaque evening-fashion garment. Face, both hands, the gathered hair mass, torso, editorial environment, garment edge, contact shadow, and gravity remain legible together. Face and the changed boundary are the first two readable focal relations after thumbnail reduction, and releasing the hair back across that interval erases the controlled-reveal proposition.
subject: one unmistakably adult fashion subject with an oval face, softly tapered jaw, balanced facial proportions, long dark wavy hair, and visible natural skin texture
setting: a riverside art-center loggia with fluted concrete columns and a reflecting pool during an overcast spring evening with soft drizzle beyond the shelter
event: both visible hands gather her long dark wavy hair into an unfinished low twist, moving the hair away from one stable upper-back and shoulder interval framed by the garment edge
visual_priorities: her face and the changed hair-and-garment boundary are the first two readable focal relations
both hands, the gathered hair mass, the exact revealed interval, the opaque garment edge, contact shadow, and gravity remain jointly legible
baseline_prompt_en: Create a polished vertical fashion-catalog photograph of one unmistakably adult fashion subject standing in a riverside art-center loggia with fluted concrete columns and a reflecting pool during an overcast spring evening, with soft drizzle visible beyond the shelter. Use the supplied reference only for her oval face, softly tapered jaw, balanced visible adult facial proportions, long dark wavy hair, and natural skin texture. Frame a waist-up three-quarter rear view while she turns her head enough for her full face to remain clear. Both visible hands gather her long dark wavy hair into an unfinished low twist. The lifted, tensioned hair mass visibly moves away from one exact stable interval of upper back and outer shoulder, producing a subtle controlled reveal created only by the hair-moving action. That bounded interval sits between the gathered hair and the tailored edge of a fully opaque bronze silk-crepe evening dress with an asymmetrical shoulder line and tailored back panel. The dress reads immediately as a recognizable complete evening garment. A narrow contact shadow follows the former hair line, loose lower waves obey gravity, and releasing the gathered hair would cover that exact same interval again. Her face and the changed hair-and-garment boundary are the first two readable focal relations. Keep both hands, gathered hair, face, torso, garment edge, and the architectural setting simultaneously legible. Photograph with a 58 mm lens from chest height; use soft directional window light, wet-stone reflections, restrained bronze and cool-gray color contrast, and crisp catalog-grade fabric detail. A small brass coat-check token rests naturally on the stone ledge.
